title: Remove ghost fat highlight doubles
description:
Plan View was drawing highlights twice: once from baked PDF ink annotations (often oversized after the zoom bug) and once from the editable SVG overlay (correct size). That looked like a correct line with a huge yellow ghost behind it.

Canvas PDF rendering now skips annotations in Viewer and Map Builder so only the SVG layer shows while you edit. Downloads/shares still include baked annots for external readers.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync after deploy.
changeLog: Disable PDF.js annotation painting under Plan View canvases (no ghost doubles).
Bust continuous-viewer tile cache so old annotated tiles are not reused.
Map Builder canvas render also skips baked ink annots.
